watch.summary: A streamer screams and falls completely out of his chair while reacting to a pro Valorant player missing a clutch shot.

beats.what: Streamer watches pro player Cryo holding an angle with an Operator.
Cryo fires and gets instantly eliminated.
Streamer screams in agony and drops out of his chair onto the floor.
Streamer climbs back into his chair in complete shock and disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The clip relies on physical slapstick as the streamer dramatically tumbles completely out of frame. The sharp contrast between high caster tension and the sudden failed play fuels his over-the-top shock.
